topic: Crude Oil Price Surge and Energy Sector Profits
summary: Crude oil prices surged toward six-month highs above $117 per barrel driven by rising tensions with Iran and supply disruption fears, delivering record profits for major energy companies while increasing macroeconomic import pressures.
